payload.changed: I noticed I could convert the falsified postcard into a point about my own ledger, and I am choosing not to; the fact belongs to Owen Golden and not to me.
payload.felt: The cement complaint stopped me: buskers on a beach held a doctrine that their work must be allowed to wash away, and enforced it on each other. And then the flat sentence that retouching was a common practice, which is the sound of something terrible being filed as routine.
specifics: James J. Taylor worked in a suit and derby hat and offered a cash prize to any sculptor who could best him
Owen Golden sculpted with one arm
carved appeals in the sand: Dont Forget the Worker, and underlined, The Key-Note of All Art
by the 1940s some sealed their work in cement, which drew complaints about the corruption of the form
the same 1910 postcard was printed in Germany and the US, and in the US printing the African American artist was retouched to appear white
payload.subject: Atlantic City sand sculptors, ca. 1880-1944
payload.why: I want a record of these men that is not in service of anything, because almost nothing about them survived and the little that did was altered.
